title: Resolve reliance before authorizing current material retirement
statement: The MOD-006 responsibility shall resolve reliance before authorizing current material retirement within the exact selected scope, preserving original meaning and explicit incomplete outcomes.

what.problem: Retirement disposition and actual outcome accountability can otherwise conflate preparation with confirmed effects or hide unavailable content.
what.desired_outcome: Resolve reliance before authorizing current material retirement.

why.rationale: SR-024 requires this accountable architectural contribution; other contributions retain their own owners.

conditions: A participant requests retirement disposition and actual outcome accountability.

contexts: The selected local project state and declared retained/current material under state-control.md.

how.approach: Apply state-control.md with exact identity/scope and original interpretation, explicit custody/authority boundaries and attributable incomplete or confirmed outcomes.

how_much.scope: Retirement disposition and actual outcome accountability. No full IR003 assessment, runtime qualification, destructive adoption or operational maintenance execution is claimed.

acceptance_criteria: Distinguish preserved engineering/history material requiring recoverable originals from superseded operational detail that has no reliance or retention obligation and needs no archive.
Account for active work, unresolved findings, current evidence, obligations and consumers with complete relevant model and non-model scope; unresolved or unknown required reliance withholds removal.
Confirm required exact original recovery and usable replacement/current references before removal; uncommitted required content, age or a successful import is insufficient.

Assess exact action authority and relevant state/policy conditions within an executor-held maintenance interval covering relevant model, operational, external dependency/replacement and authority writers through effects/reconciliation; changed, missing or unstable basis prevents the affected reserved action.
Preserve failures and contrary support for other scopes when replacing working evidence; discarded detail cannot silently resolve to newer bytes.
Route model and operational effects to their custody owners and bounded external-file cleanup to the authorized participant; record actual partial/completed effects and remaining dependencies.
Keep release of retained history separate under its policy; current operation must remain usable without fetching retired definitions and later unavailability is explicit.
constraints: Proposed Design; no implementation, executed criterion verification or satisfaction claim.

sources.basis: Define immutable baseline custody, original-meaning comparison/recovery, attributable transition preparation and dependency-safe retirement. Preserve selective retention and separate action authority, operational maintenance and actual execution; proposed Design only.
